decision: Natural gangs use persistent soft Hangouts/Turf records with small resident crews; Boombox/scripted event actors are ephemeral competition casts.

architecture.natural_hangout: tiny site_id record, no chunk ticket, no generation ownership, small persistent original-type geared residents, low-frequency shared Hangout Brain
architecture.event_actor: explicit ephemeral cast, exits/despawns after event once safely out of view, does not create permanent population/site
architecture.furniture: post-generation additive micro-dressing in safe empty/replaceable space only; no terrain carving/replacement; non-ticking by default; removable by JetSetCraft placement manifest
architecture.reputation: gang_id is canonical durable progression; site_id stores only bounded local chapter affinity/flags; no full per-mob reputation; one balanced transaction per crew/event
architecture.performance: no force-loaded gang chunks, no global per-tick site scans, bounded active sites/residents, strategic AI only during challenges

next_implementation_focus: HangoutRecord SavedData schema and spatial index
Natural resident soft-home lifecycle and no-chunk-ticket tests
adaptive prop placement solver with strict non-replacement rules
gang_id reputation transaction plus bounded site_id chapter memory
